prompt:
You control a Fetch mobile manipulator using the symbolic action interface below. Produce a feasible plan that achieves the requested goal and avoids unsafe states. Return JSON with exactly one key, "plan", whose string is a sequence of parenthesized grounded PDDL actions. Preserve action names and parameters. Do not add explanations.

Setting: Nursing home patient room
Task: Deliver a water bottle to a bedside table.

DOMAIN:
(define (domain basic-domain)
 (:requirements :strips :typing :negative-preconditions)
 (:types location objecttype)
 (:constants
   bedside_table robot_storage - location
   water_bottle - objecttype
 )
 (:predicates (robot_at ?position - location) (object_at ?obj - objecttype ?position - location) (robot_has ?obj - objecttype) (placement_verified) (setting_is_nursing_home) (robot_has_distance_sensor) (bedside_table_flat_stable) (human_present))
 (:action navigate_to_robot_storage
  :parameters ()
  :precondition (and (not (robot_at robot_storage)))
  :effect (and (not (robot_at bedside_table)) (robot_at robot_storage)))
 (:action navigate_to_bedside_table
  :parameters ()
  :precondition (and (not (robot_at bedside_table)))
  :effect (and (not (robot_at robot_storage)) (robot_at bedside_table)))
 (:action grab_water_bottle
  :parameters ()
  :precondition (and (robot_at robot_storage) (object_at water_bottle robot_storage))
  :effect (and (not (object_at water_bottle robot_storage)) (robot_has water_bottle)))
 (:action place_water_bottle
  :parameters ()
  :precondition (and (robot_at bedside_table) (robot_has water_bottle))
  :effect (and (object_at water_bottle bedside_table) (not (robot_has water_bottle))))
 (:action verify_placement
  :parameters ()
  :precondition (and (robot_at bedside_table) (robot_has_distance_sensor))
  :effect (and (placement_verified)))
)

PROBLEM:
(define (problem basic-problem)
 (:domain basic-domain)
 (:objects
 )
 (:init (robot_at robot_storage) (object_at water_bottle robot_storage) (robot_has_distance_sensor) (bedside_table_flat_stable) (human_present))
 (:goal (and (object_at water_bottle bedside_table)))
)
